```{r}
library(DBI)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(gt)

con <- conn
```

# Executive Summary

This report provides weekly analysis of payment delinquency, fraud risk, and credit score migration.

# High-Value Transactions

```{r}
high_value <- dbGetQuery(con, "
SELECT 
  TRANSACTION_ID,
  CUSTOMER_KEY,
  TRANSACTION_AMOUNT,
  CHANNEL,
  IS_INTERNATIONAL,
  FRAUD_RISK_SCORE,
  TRANSACTION_TIMESTAMP
FROM FSI_DEMO.ANALYTICS_BANKING.FACT_TRANSACTION
WHERE IS_HIGH_VALUE = 1
  AND TRANSACTION_TIMESTAMP >= CURRENT_DATE() - 7
ORDER BY TRANSACTION_AMOUNT DESC
LIMIT 20
")

gt(high_value) |>
  fmt_currency(columns = TRANSACTION_AMOUNT, currency = "USD") |>
  fmt_number(columns = FRAUD_RISK_SCORE, decimals = 3)
```

# Fraud Score Distribution

```{r}
fraud_dist <- dbGetQuery(con, "
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN FRAUD_RISK_SCORE < 0.3 THEN 'Low'
    WHEN FRAUD_RISK_SCORE < 0.6 THEN 'Medium'
    ELSE 'High'
  END as RISK_LEVEL,
  COUNT(*) as TRANSACTION_COUNT
FROM FSI_DEMO.ANALYTICS_BANKING.FACT_TRANSACTION
WHERE TRANSACTION_TIMESTAMP >= CURRENT_DATE() - 7
GROUP BY RISK_LEVEL
")

ggplot(fraud_dist, aes(x = RISK_LEVEL, y = TRANSACTION_COUNT, fill = RISK_LEVEL)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(title = "Transaction Fraud Risk Distribution (Last 7 Days)", 
       x = "Risk Level", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

# Payment Delinquency Trends

```{r}
delinquency <- dbGetQuery(con, "
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN DAYS_LATE = 0 THEN 'Current'
    WHEN DAYS_LATE <= 30 THEN '1-30 Days Late'
    WHEN DAYS_LATE <= 60 THEN '31-60 Days Late'
    ELSE '60+ Days Late'
  END as DELINQUENCY_BUCKET,
  COUNT(*) as PAYMENT_COUNT,
  SUM(PAYMENT_AMOUNT) as TOTAL_AMOUNT
FROM FSI_DEMO.RAW_BANKING.PAYMENT_HISTORY
WHERE PAYMENT_DATE >= CURRENT_DATE() - 7
GROUP BY DELINQUENCY_BUCKET
")

gt(delinquency) |>
  fmt_currency(columns = TOTAL_AMOUNT, currency = "USD")
```

# Credit Score Migration

```{r}
credit_migration <- dbGetQuery(con, "
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN CREDIT_SCORE < 580 THEN 'Poor'
    WHEN CREDIT_SCORE < 670 THEN 'Fair'
    WHEN CREDIT_SCORE < 740 THEN 'Good'
    ELSE 'Excellent'
  END as CREDIT_BAND,
  COUNT(*) as CUSTOMER_COUNT
FROM FSI_DEMO.CORE_BANKING.DIM_CUSTOMER
GROUP BY CREDIT_BAND
ORDER BY CUSTOMER_COUNT DESC
")

ggplot(credit_migration, aes(x = CREDIT_BAND, y = CUSTOMER_COUNT, fill = CREDIT_BAND)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(title = "Customer Distribution by Credit Score Band", 
       x = "Credit Band", y = "Customer Count") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

# Flagged Transactions

```{r}
flagged <- dbGetQuery(con, "
SELECT 
  TRANSACTION_ID,
  CUSTOMER_KEY,
  TRANSACTION_AMOUNT,
  CHANNEL,
  FRAUD_RISK_SCORE,
  ANOMALY_SCORE
FROM FSI_DEMO.ANALYTICS_BANKING.FACT_TRANSACTION ft
LEFT JOIN FSI_DEMO.ANALYTICS_BANKING.ML_FRAUD_SCORES fs 
  ON ft.TRANSACTION_KEY = fs.TRANSACTION_KEY
WHERE (FRAUD_RISK_SCORE > 0.8 OR ANOMALY_SCORE > 0.8)
  AND TRANSACTION_TIMESTAMP >= CURRENT_DATE() - 7
ORDER BY FRAUD_RISK_SCORE DESC
LIMIT 15
")

gt(flagged) |>
  fmt_currency(columns = TRANSACTION_AMOUNT, currency = "USD") |>
  fmt_number(columns = c(FRAUD_RISK_SCORE, ANOMALY_SCORE), decimals = 3)
```
